chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sa'd ibn Isma'il from his father who said:

I said to al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'If a man commits sins and he is knowledgeable of this matter, should I pray behind him?' He said, 'No.' And there is no objection if a man leads women [in prayer] and a woman also leads women.
ai.seo_question: Who is eligible to lead congregational prayer if they are known sinners, and can women lead other women?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) rules that one should not pray behind a man who is known to commit sins, distinguishing between general sinfulness and specific knowledge of it. Additionally, he permits men to lead women in congregational prayer and women to lead other women.
